instruction:
A BBQ grill grate is on the kitchen countertop with sticky residue on its surface. You have a flat scraper (scraper_801). Clean the grill by placing the scraper at the front edge and pushing it forward in a single motion to the end. You must complete the cleaning in one push.

You will need to define the exact 6-DOF physical parameters (linear velocity, applied force, orientation angles) for the push.
